body:
# XPTracker

**Track every point of XP you earn and find out where it comes from!**

This lightweight client-side Fabric mod monitors your experience gains in real time, breaks them down by source, and displays everything in a clean, configurable HUD overlay.

## Features

### Session Tracking
- **Total XP gained** - See exactly how much experience you've earned this session
- **Level gains** - Track how many levels you've gained since starting
- **Session time** - Know how long you've been grinding
- **XP per minute** - Measure your farming efficiency in real time

### Source Detection
- **Combat** - XP from killing mobs
- **Mining** - XP from breaking ores (Coal, Diamond, Emerald, Lapis, Redstone, Nether Quartz, Nether Gold, Sculk, Spawners)
- **Smelting** - XP from collecting furnace outputs
- **Trading** - XP from villager trades
- **Fishing** - XP from reeling in catches
- **Breeding** - XP from breeding animals
- **Percentage breakdown** - See which sources contribute most to your XP

### Smart Session Management
- **Toggle tracking** - Start and pause freely with a single keybind
- **Auto-pause** - Automatically pauses when you open the pause menu
- **Auto-resume** - Picks back up when you return to the game
- **Session persistence** - Optionally keep your session across world changes
- **Chat summary** - Detailed breakdown printed to chat when you reset

### Customizable HUD
- **Four positions** - Top-left, top-right, bottom-left, bottom-right
- **Adjustable scale** - Make it bigger or smaller
- **Custom colors** - Choose text and background colors
- **Toggle individual stats** - Show only what you care about
- **Background opacity** - Adjust for readability

### Player-Friendly
- **Keybinds** - `J` to toggle tracking, `K` to reset session
- **In-game config** - Full YACL config screen via ModMenu
- **Bilingual** - English and German translations included
- **Client-side only** - No server installation required

## Requirements

- **Minecraft**: 26.1+
- **Fabric Loader**: 0.18.4 or higher
- **Fabric API**: Required
- **Java**: 25 or higher
- **ModMenu** + **YACL**: Optional (for in-game config screen)

## Perfect For

- **Grinders** - Measure and optimize your XP farming setups
- **Builders** - Track XP from mining sessions
- **Traders** - See how much XP villager trading actually gives you
- **Everyone** - Anyone curious about where their XP comes from!
